verdict.rationale: Docs mention Droid being asked to 'investigate, implement, and test the work' when delegated via Linear/Jira, and general workflow docs reference tests and CI/CD pipelines, implying the agent can run tests as part of its workflow. However, there's no dedicated documentation describing automatic test generation or a self-validation loop before proposing changes. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of automated test generation/execution as a pre-proposal validation step, and independent/hands-on confirmation that tests are run before diffs are presented.
